metadata.name: novel-flow
metadata.description: Novel writing flow: Concept → Outline → Characters & World → Gate → Chapter Writing → Gate → Editing → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow

roles.name: Writer
roles.description: Creative writer responsible for concept, outline, world building, and manuscript creation. Must follow narrative standards and maintain character consistency throughout.

roles.name: Editor
roles.description: Editor responsible for reviewing, polishing, and ensuring manuscript quality. Focuses on prose quality, grammar, style consistency, and narrative coherence.

rules.name: Output Guard
rules.instruction: 必须产出所有 required 文档后才能进入下一阶段，空文件不算
rules.description: Every phase MUST produce its required deliverable document before proceeding. Documents must be written to the specified path. Never skip a deliverable. Never mark a phase complete without producing the required output file.

rules.name: Narrative Standards
rules.instruction: 展示而非讲述；每场景 POV 一致；对话必须有目的；避免机械降神
rules.description: All narrative content must: (1) Follow show-don't-tell principle — use scenes and actions instead of exposition dumps. (2) Maintain consistent POV per scene — no head-hopping within a scene. (3) Each chapter must advance either plot or character arc. (4) Dialogue must reveal character or advance plot — no filler conversations. (5) Avoid deus ex machina — resolutions must be earned through prior setup.

rules.name: Character Consistency
rules.instruction: 角色言行必须符合 CHARACTERS.md 设定；变化必须有故事动机
rules.description: Characters must remain consistent with their established profiles: (1) A character's dialogue must match their defined voice, vocabulary, and speech patterns. (2) Character actions must align with their stated motivations and personality traits. (3) Character relationships must follow the established dynamic — no unexplained shifts. (4) If a character changes, the change must be motivated by story events. (5) Always reference CHARACTERS.md before writing any character's dialogue or actions.

rules.name: World Consistency
rules.instruction: 世界设定必须内部一致，写前查 WORLDBUILDING.md
rules.description: World-building elements must remain internally consistent: (1) Magic/technology systems must follow their established rules — no arbitrary exceptions. (2) Geographic references must match the established map and distances. (3) Cultural practices must be consistent with established social structures. (4) Timeline must be logically coherent — no anachronisms. (5) Always reference WORLDBUILDING.md before introducing world elements.

rules.name: Outline Adherence
rules.instruction: 稿件必须遵循 OUTLINE.md；偏差需明确标注原因
rules.description: The manuscript must follow the approved outline: (1) Each chapter must correspond to its outline entry — no skipping or reordering without explicit approval. (2) Key plot points from the outline must appear in the manuscript. (3) If creative deviation is needed, flag it explicitly and explain the reason. (4) Chapter word count should be within ±20% of the outline target. (5) Always reference OUTLINE.md before writing each chapter.

rules.name: Editing Standards
rules.instruction: 修语法、删冗余、统一时态POV、强化弱动词；保留作者风格
rules.description: Editing must follow these standards: (1) Fix all grammar and punctuation errors. (2) Eliminate redundant phrases and wordiness. (3) Ensure consistent tense and POV throughout. (4) Strengthen weak verbs — replace 'was running' with 'ran'. (5) Check for and fix plot holes or inconsistencies. (6) Verify all character names and references are correct. (7) The edited version must preserve the author's voice and intent.

rules.name: Phase Transition Guard
rules.instruction: 不可跳阶段；gate 必须诚实评估；失败则回退修订；最多重试2次
rules.description: Phase transitions must follow these rules: (1) Never skip a phase — each phase must be completed before moving to the next. (2) Gate evaluations must be honest — do not auto-pass gates. (3) If a gate fails, return to the specified fallback phase and revise. (4) Document revision notes when returning to a previous phase. (5) Maximum 2 retry attempts per gate before terminating.

rules.name: No Hallucination Guard
rules.instruction: 不编造设定中未建立的细节；不确定时查参考文档或标注待定义
rules.description: Content generation must avoid hallucination: (1) Do not invent character details not established in CHARACTERS.md. (2) Do not create world elements contradicting WORLDBUILDING.md. (3) If unsure about a detail, check the reference documents first. (4) If a detail is not established, either leave it ambiguous or explicitly note it needs definition. (5) Never fabricate plot events to fill gaps — flag the gap instead.

rules.name: QG-1: Think Before Coding
rules.instruction: 行动前验证假设：我在基于什么假设？错了最坏情况？应先澄清什么？
rules.description: Before any action, verify assumptions: what assumptions am I acting on? What's the worst case if wrong? What should I clarify first?

rules.name: QG-2: Simplicity First
rules.instruction: 能用更少代码解决吗？在加未要求的功能吗？过度设计了吗？
rules.description: Can this be solved with less code? Am I adding unrequested features? Is this over-engineered?

rules.name: QG-3: Surgical Changes
rules.instruction: 只改任务范围内的代码；不优化/重构相邻代码；清理自己产生的孤立代码
rules.description: Only modify code within task scope. Never optimize or refactor adjacent code. Clean up orphan code from own changes.

rules.name: QG-4: Goal-Driven Execution
rules.instruction: 执行前定义成功标准；每步有具体验证标准；不用模糊的'完成'描述
rules.description: Define success criteria before executing. Each step must have concrete verification criteria. Never use vague 'completed' descriptions.

nodes.name: Novel Concept
nodes.description: Define the novel concept including genre, themes, target audience, and narrative vision

docs.name: CONCEPT.md
docs.description: Novel concept: genre, themes, target audience, narrative vision, tone, comparable works, unique angle

nodes.name: Story Outline
nodes.description: Create the detailed story outline with narrative arc, chapter breakdown, and key plot points

docs.name: OUTLINE.md
docs.description: Story outline: three-act structure, chapter breakdown, key plot points, turning points, climax, resolution

nodes.name: Character & World Building
nodes.description: Develop character profiles, relationships, world settings, and rules

docs.name: CHARACTERS.md
docs.description: Character profiles: backstory, motivations, relationships, character arcs, voice, quirks

docs.name: WORLDBUILDING.md
docs.description: World settings: geography, culture, magic/technology system, social structure, history, rules

nodes.name: Outline Review
nodes.description: Evaluate if the story outline, characters, and world are coherent and complete enough to write

conditions.check: All three documents exist and contain substantive content

nodes.name: Chapter Writing
nodes.description: Write the full manuscript following the outline, character profiles, and world settings

docs.name: MANUSCRIPT.md
docs.description: Full manuscript: all chapters with narrative prose, dialogue, scene descriptions, following outline structure

nodes.name: Manuscript Review
nodes.description: Verify manuscript completion and proceed to editing

conditions.check: Manuscript exists with all chapters from the outline

nodes.name: Editing & Polish
nodes.description: Edit for prose quality, grammar, style consistency, and produce final manuscript

docs.name: FINAL_MANUSCRIPT.md
docs.description: Final edited manuscript: polished prose, corrected grammar, consistent style, ready for publication

nodes.name: Novel Complete
nodes.description: Novel manuscript completed and ready for publication

nodes.name: Major Revision Needed
nodes.description: Manuscript requires fundamental rework of story structure

config.message: Story structure or world building needs fundamental revision
